name: Concerted Efforts
label: Quest
description: Concerted Efforts: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, friend. I hope you continue to lend your experience to the different battlefronts. A lot of our lads and lasses in the field look up to seasoned veterans like you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You live up to yer reputation, friend. Without people like you, the Alliance wouldn't stand a chance against the savage forces of the Horde.
